title: thelesperma graminiformis
intro: Thelesperma graminiformis, commonly known as Gray's hairy brittleweed, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Thelesperma graminiformis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage.
